notes: Read SKILL.md in full (the only file). The skill is a reference for running containers on Amazon ECS/Fargate: cluster creation, ECR push, task definitions, services behind an ALB, rolling deployments, ECS Exec, auto scaling, a Terraform equivalent, log viewing and a troubleshooting table.

Medium: following it has the agent run AWS CLI and Docker commands with the user's configured AWS credentials that create clusters, ECR repositories, log groups and services, push images, force new deployments, register scaling policies, deregister an old task definition revision (SKILL.md:138) and open an interactive shell in a running task (SKILL.md:201-206). Acceptable because these are standard deployment steps for the user's own workload; there are no delete-cluster/delete-service commands, no firewall or security-control changes, and ECR login uses --password-stdin (SKILL.md:61-62).

Examples use placeholder account 123456789012 and a cluster literally named 'production'; users should substitute their own names and confirm before running deployment commands against real environments. Prerequisites and Related Skills (SKILL.md:29, 368-372) link to sibling skills ../aws-vpc/, ../aws-iam/, ../terraform-aws/ and ../../../devops/containers/{docker-management,container-registries}/ as optional reading only.
